source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 1 Überschr. Εἰ τοίνυν «μακάριοι οἱ κλαίοντες, ὅτι γελάσονται«, ἔδει Ἱερεμίαν τὸν μυστικὸν τοῦτον κλαῦσαι κλαυθμὸν καὶ κατὰ τὸ «μακάριοι οἱ πενθοὺντες« πενθῆσαι τοῦς τοῦ πενθεῖσθαι ἀξίους.
pass_a_gloss: If then “blessed are those who weep, for they will laugh,” Jeremiah had to weep this mystical klauthmos / weeping and, according to “blessed are those who mourn,” mourn those worthy of being mourned.
pass_b_english: If then “blessed are those who weep, for they will laugh,” Jeremiah had to weep this mystical weeping and, according to “blessed are those who mourn,” mourn those worthy of being mourned.

choices.why: Origen’s continuous verb for Jeremiah’s alphabetic thrēnoi.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.
